Name: Seasonal Seed Drops
Author: chyyo
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

你是否还在为每次买什么种子而苦恼？现在，玩家在正常游玩时，可以在地图上采集到种子包，获得当前季节可种植的随机种子。

砍树、割草、打怪、翻垃圾桶和钓鱼宝箱中也都有几率掉落种子。此 mod 主要是为了增添一些随机乐趣。为了游戏平衡，每次获得的种子数量最多为 9 颗（可在 GMCM 中修改，默认为 3 颗），稀有种子最多为 3 颗。

Are you tired of wondering which seeds to buy every time? With this mod, players can find seed pouches while foraging on maps during normal gameplay. These pouches contain random seeds that can be planted in the current season.

Seeds also have a chance to drop from chopping trees, cutting grass, killing monsters, checking garbage cans, and fishing treasure chests. This mod is mainly meant to add a bit of random fun. For balance, the number of seeds you can receive each time is limited to a maximum of 9. This can be changed in GMCM. The default amount is 3 seeds, and rare seeds are limited to a maximum of 3.


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]

解压文件，并将文件夹放入 Mods 文件夹中。

Unzip the file and place the folder in your Mods folder.


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]如果安装了 Generic Mod Config Menu，本 mod 会在游戏内配置菜单里显示选项。
可以调整：[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]地图生成概率。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]每张地图每天生成几个种子包，范围限制在 0-9。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]每个地图种子包包含几颗种子，范围限制在 1-9，默认 2-8。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]多张户外地图是否启用，可以单独 opt out。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]割草、砍树、打怪、垃圾桶、钓鱼宝箱的额外掉落概率。[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]玩法掉落的种子数量范围。[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]地图生成设置在重新读档或进入下一天后生效。[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]If Generic Mod Config Menu is installed, this mod will show its options in the in-game configuration menu.
You can adjust:[/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Map generation chance.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]How many seed spots are generated on each map per day, limited to a range of 0–9.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]How many seeds each map seed spot contains, limited to a range of 1–9. Default: 2–8.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Whether multiple outdoor maps are enabled; each map can be opted out individually.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extra drop chances from cutting grass, chopping trees, killing monsters, trash cans, and fishing treasure chests.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Seed quantity range for gameplay drops.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Should be able to include all mod-added seeds as well. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia Crops [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Flowers [/url]tested.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url] is compatible.[/color]
